I have an account on [Book Hero](https://bookhero.co.nz/) and have favourited some books ready to purchase.

However, there are some upcoming books that are not listed there on Book Hero, so, I have a list below to remind myself of the books I am waiting for.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(gt)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Create the dataset with web links for images and info
books_data <- tribble(
  ~cover_url, ~title, ~author, ~publish_date, ~info_url, ~notes,
  
  "",
  "The Infinte Extent - Bobiverse Book 6", 
  "Dennis E. Taylor", 
  "TBA", 
  "https://youtube.com", 
  "",
  
  "", 
  "TBA - Bobiverse Book 7", 
  "Dennis E. Taylor", 
  "TBA", 
  "http://dennisetaylor.org", 
  "",
  
  "https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/malazan/images/0/04/Legacies_of_Betrayal_Bantam_UK_HC.webp/revision/latest?cb=20260507214927", 
  "Legacies of Betrayal - The Tales of Witness Book 3", 
  "Steven Erikson", 
  "October 2026", 
  "https://malazan.fandom.com/wiki/Legacies_of_Betrayal", 
  "",
  
  "", 
  "The Last God - The Tales of Witness Book 4", 
  "Steven Erikson", 
  "TBA", 
  "https://malazan.fandom.com/wiki/The_Last_God",
  "",
  
  "", 
  "Walk in Shadow - Kharkanas Trilogy Book 3", 
  "Steven Erikson", 
  "TBA", 
  "https://www.facebook.com/steveneriksonofficial/posts/hello-everyone-this-post-is-an-update-i-am-presently-writing-walk-in-shadow-the-/1195726948574858/",
  "",
  
  "", 
  "The Last Champion - Paths to Ascendancy Book 5", 
  "Ian C. Esslemont", 
  "April 2027", 
  "https://malazan.fandom.com/wiki/The_Last_Champion",
  ""
) 


# 2. Build and format the gt table
books_data |>
  gt() |>
  # Rename columns for presentation
  cols_label(
    cover_url = "",
    title = "Title",
    author = "Author",
    publish_date = "Expected Publish Date",
    info_url = "Info Link",
    notes = "Notes"
  ) |>
  # Transform the cover_url text column into actual HTML images
  text_transform(
    locations = cells_body(columns = cover_url),
    fn = function(x) {
      web_image(url = x, height = 80)
    }
  ) |>
  # Transform the info_url into a clickable link button/text
  text_transform(
    locations = cells_body(columns = info_url),
    fn = function(x) {
      paste0('<a href="', x, '" target="_blank" style="text-decoration: underline; color: currentColor;">View Link 🔗</a>')
    }
  ) |>
  # Safe table layout options (No invalid color strings allowed here)
  tab_options(
    table.width = pct(100),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
    quarto.use_bootstrap = TRUE              # Seamless bootstrap support
  ) |>
  # Injection layer bypasses R's validation check and speaks directly to the browser
  opt_css(
    "
    table.gt_table, .gt_row, .gt_col_heading {
      color: inherit !important;
      background-color: transparent !important;
    }
    "
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(cover_url, publish_date, info_url)
  )
```


<p style="text-align: center; margin-top: 2rem; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; color: gray;">
  This page has been read <span id="goat-count" style="font-weight: bold; color: currentColor;">...</span> times.
</p>

<script>
  // Point directly to your unique bengin sub-domain endpoint
  fetch('https://bengin.goatcounter.com/counter//book_list.json')
    .then(response => {
        // If it's a 404 error, GoatCounter is saying "This page has 0 historical views"
        if (response.status === 404) {
          return { count: 0 }; 
        }
        // Catch actual fatal server network drops
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error('API or CORS issue');
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(data => {
        // Seamless pluralization checker for perfect grammar
        let count = data.count;
        document.getElementById('goat-count').innerText = count;
      })
      .catch(err => {
        // Only falls back to "a few" if an adblocker blocks the connection completely
        document.getElementById('goat-count').innerText = "a few";
      });
</script>
